services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: The Contemporary Dayton is proud to present Niki Johnson: Pillars of Democracy, a series of four large-scale collaged portraits envisioning Liberty, Justice, Freedom, and Forward as first-time voters from Milwaukee. Set across Wisconsin landscapes at dawn, midday, dusk, and night, the works reflect how democratic values are lived, protected, and renewed at the local level. The Contemporary Dayton is proud to announce The Contemporary Dayton 2025, its biennial Members’ exhibition. Celebrating the talent, creativity, and vision of both emerging and established artists, this exhibition has been a cornerstone of The Contemporary Dayton’s community programming since 1991.
